faqs.question: Is Taraweeh prayer obligatory?
faqs.answer: Taraweeh is not one of the five obligatory daily prayers. It is commonly taught as a Sunnah or voluntary Ramadan night prayer, with details explained by local scholars and madhhabs.

faqs.question: How many rak'ahs are in Taraweeh?
faqs.answer: Muslim communities differ in practice. Many pray 8 or 20 rak'ahs before Witr, and some communities follow other local scholarly guidance. Follow your imam or the madhhab you have learned.

faqs.question: When is Taraweeh prayed?
faqs.answer: Taraweeh is prayed after Isha during Ramadan, usually before Witr in many communities. It may be prayed in congregation at the mosque or individually.

hero.introductionHtml: Taraweeh is the Ramadan night prayer Muslims pray after Isha, often in congregation, as a way to stand in worship, listen to Quran, and seek Allah's forgiveness.
hero.summaryHtml:
• When: after Isha during Ramadan, usually before Witr.
  • Purpose: standing in night prayer, reciting or listening to Quran, and seeking forgiveness.
  • Common practice: many communities pray it in congregation at the mosque.
  • Note: rak'ah counts differ, so follow your imam or madhhab.
